# Yomu

> A Japanese reader at https://yomu.neorgon.com/: paste a line and it is split
> into words, with furigana over the kanji, a romaji line for how it is said
> (Genki's convention: sayoonara, sensee, watashi wa) and one for how it is
> spelled (sa-yo-u-na-ra), notes on the special sounds and the grammar in the
> line, and a table of its kanji. Everything runs in the browser from
> committed dictionary files. Any Neorgon site on the allowlist can embed it
> in an iframe and send it text over postMessage. Nothing is uploaded.

## What a reading contains

Each token has a kind (word, inflected, particle, copula, katakana, name,
number, punct, and a few more), its surface, its dictionary form, its reading
in hiragana, furigana per kanji where the data allows, its beats, and two
romaji lines:

- said: long vowels doubled only inside one morpheme (思う stays omou),
  particles は へ を read wa e o, n' before a vowel or y, never macrons
- spelled: kana by kana with a hyphen between beats

Sound notes: particle-wa, particle-e, particle-o, fossil-wa (こんにちは),
long-vowel, small-tsu, youon, dakuten, handakuten, n-assimilation, devoiced
(written s(u)kides(u)), ji-zu, foreign-sound, bar, repeat-mark,
special-reading (今日 read as a whole), counter-change (いっぷん).

Grammar notes: every particle, the copula forms, polite and plain verb
endings, te-forms (te-kudasai, te-iru, te-shimau, te-miru), desire, potential,
passive, causative, volitional, imperative, the conditionals ば, たら, なら and
と, i-adjective forms, invitations and offers.

The full contract, including the token shape, is docs/ANALYZER.md in the
repository: https://github.com/energon-a-secas/yomu-site

## Embedding Yomu: yomu-embed/1

Frame URL: https://yomu.neorgon.com/?embed=1&lang=en (or lang=es). A top-level
page with ?embed=1 shows the normal site, because a frame with no host would
have nothing to read.

Text never travels in the frame URL. Every message is { v: 1, type, ... }.

Host to Yomu:

- yomu:hello (no fields): post it on the iframe's load event; Yomu can be
  ready before the host listens
- yomu:load { text, lang? }: read this text, at most 2,000 characters
- yomu:lang { lang }: switch the interface language

Yomu to host:

- yomu:ready { version }: on boot and in reply to every hello
- yomu:height { height }: the document height in CSS pixels, at most once per
  animation frame, so the host can size the frame
- yomu:read { tokens, unknown }: a load finished; unknown counts the tokens
  with no dictionary support
- yomu:error { message }: a load could not be read

Yomu accepts messages only from https://runcible.neorgon.com and Runcible's
development server (http://localhost:8878, http://127.0.0.1:8878), checks
that the message came from its parent window, and posts only to the origin of
the last accepted hello. A new host is added to js/embed.js and docs/EMBED.md
in the same commit.

The embedded page keeps its text box, so a host that opens Yomu as a page of
its own (no text sent) still lets the learner paste.

## Linking to Yomu with text

https://yomu.neorgon.com/#t=<encodeURIComponent(text)> reads the text once and
then removes the fragment. Build this only for text you authored (a lesson's
phrase), never for text a person typed.

## Privacy

The pasted text is kept only in this browser's localStorage under
yomu-site:text so a reload keeps it, with a visible Clear. It is never put in
the URL, the page title or an attribute. The DeepL and Google Translate
links are built at the moment they are clicked, which is the only way the
text leaves the page.

## Data and licences

- JMdict and KANJIDIC, by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development
  Group, CC BY-SA 4.0: the glosses, readings and kanji information
- KanjiVG, by Ulrich Apel, CC BY-SA 3.0: the parts of each kanji
- Tatoeba, CC BY 2.0 FR: used only to rank how common each word is; no
  sentence ships
- The phrase library, the notes and the deinflection rules are written for
  Yomu and are public domain. Nothing is taken from Genki, the Japan
  Foundation apps, Tofugu, Yomitan, rikaichan or 10ten.
